about: Linda M. DiPasquale, Attorney at Law works from Niagara Square, a block from the family and supreme courts, and her own about page says she has served clients in Buffalo and the Greater Niagara region for more than thirty years. She is the named attorney.

19 reviews at 4.4. She explains seven stages of a matrimonial case, which is among the widest coverage in this market, and describes one route through one. Her site publishes a privacy policy, a disclaimer and a blog, and it publishes no rate, no retainer figure and no flat fee.
